mapper.select: select d.id, d.order_id, d.sku_id, sku.item_id, item.item_code, item.item_name, d.supplier_id, merchant.merchant_name as supplier_name, d.purchase_quantity, d.inbound_quantity, d.return_quantity, d.actual_quantity, d.remark from wms_purchase_order_detail d inner join wms_item_sku sku on sku.id = d.sku_id inner join wms_item item on item.id = sku.item_id left join wms_merchant merchant on merchant.id = d.supplier_id where d.order_id = #{orderId} order by d.id
